about_the_game:
This DLC contains words for different languages for the game. Currently only German, Japanese and Chinese in varying quality. These mainly function as examples that can be expanded upon. This will contain details on how to create your own word list for people interested in it.

The files can be found in the install folder of the game, in a folder called languages.
